fact: A WAF block/deny page frequently returns HTTP 200 ('Request Rejected', 'Your support ID is', 'Access Denied', 'Request Blocked') — a bare 200 after a bypass/injection probe is NOT proof; require a differential vs a proven-guarded baseline plus negative body matchers.

exiftool/ImageMagick route by MAGIC BYTES, not the file extension — a .jpg can carry a DjVu/SVG parser payload, and an extension allow-list is not a real control; 'image upload' == 'arbitrary parser surface'.
exiftool >= 12.24 patches CVE-2021-22204 (DjVu annotation eval) — fingerprint the version FIRST; firing the DjVu RCE on >=12.24 is a $0 patched-instance dead-end.

Smart/curly quotes (“ ” ‘ ’) silently break HTML-injection and attribute probes — a blind/failed probe is often a SYNTAX/encoding failure, not an absent vuln; re-encode (ASCII quotes, URL-encode, charset, Unicode-normalize) before concluding 'not vulnerable'.
LIBXML_NONET only blocks the http:// scheme, NOT php:// wrappers — 'NONET is set' does not mean XXE exfil is impossible; pivot to php://filter/convert.base64-encode.
PHP < 8.4 has no LIBXML_NO_XXE and defends XXE only with ad-hoc flag/DOCTYPE checks; PHP >= 8.4 adds LIBXML_NO_XXE — version-gate XXE and expect the <8.4 guards to be weaker than they read.
__free_hook and __malloc_hook were REMOVED in glibc >= 2.34 — classic hook-overwrite is a dead-end; pivot to the TLS-dtor list, FSOP/_IO_ chains, or exit handlers (with PTR_MANGLE).
house_of_force was killed in glibc >= 2.29 — do not attempt it on modern libc; use house_of_botcake/tangerine or tcache poisoning instead.
Safe-linking (glibc >= 2.32) masks tcache/fastbin fd pointers with (addr>>12) — a HEAP LEAK is required before any poison; blind-poisoning on >=2.32 fails.
ysoserial CommonsCollections1 fails above JRE 8u72 — pivot to CC6 or a non-CC chain; match the gadget chain to the classpath+JRE, do not spray all chains.

httpOnly only protects document.cookie, NOT a server that reflects the cookie value into HTML — do not write off a reflected XSS as low-impact just because the session cookie is httpOnly; hunt the server-side cookie-quote parser.

PHP folds '.', space and '[' in request/cookie parameter NAMES to '_' (register-globals-era), the browser does not — the name the server validates can differ from the name the browser sends (e.g. _ct[client_global_id -> _ct_client_global_id), a smuggling primitive.

A URL allowlist that checks the HOST does not necessarily check the PATH — once the host passes, append ../../ (or a path the fetcher normalizes after the check) to escape to an internal resource (check-then-use TOCTOU on the URL string).

A host-allowlist regex matching a SUBSTRING instead of the registrable host is bypassed by legit.com.attacker.tld / legit.com@attacker / legit.com%2f@attacker / attacker/legit.com — anchor on the registrable host.

A .git (or other) deny rule usually lives on ONE vhost/server block — the DEFAULT block (hit via raw IP or an unexpected Host header) is often the weak sibling without the deny; treat the web server as multiple configs keyed by Host.
GraphQL cost/bucket rate limiters charge per-REQUEST, not per-alias — alias batching (a:Q(id:1) b:Q(id:2) ...) multiplies an IDOR's throughput under a single charge.
A GraphQL HTTP route being 'authenticated' does NOT mean each resolver enforces per-object authz — one missing check spans the whole schema; authz-test every mutation individually.
SOCKS cannot carry raw nmap scans (layer mismatch) — use a static nmap ON the compromised host, or Ligolo-ng's tun route (tunnel_start + ip route add), not proxychains over a raw-packet scan.

proxychains versions are subtly incompatible and a SHARED gateway gets your uploaded SSH key overwritten by rivals — prefer Ligolo-ng (-selfcert, agent -connect, tunnel_start) over fragile proxychaining on a contested host.

A blind sink is an ORACLE SHAPE to convert, not a dead-end: process exit codes exfil a file byte-by-byte, error strings scan an internal network, php://filter exfils with no stdout, and time-delays give a boolean — change the oracle before concluding 'not exploitable'.
angr/miasm choke on custom-VM dispatch loops — for a virtualized rev target recover the IR grammar and write a hand emulator instead of forcing a symbolic solver.
Volatility3 cannot parse hiberfil.sys out of the box — pull the community windows.hibernation plugin PR (fetch pull/1036/head) and dump to raw instead of abandoning the artifact.

A decompiler IL that does not match observed behavior is an OBFUSCATION signal (R2R/ReadyToRun stomping: malicious native code in the R2R section while the IL stays innocent) — carve+emulate the native bytes, do not trust the IL alone.

Deserialization, dependency-confusion, argument-injection and blind-SSRF proofs are usually only recoverable OUT-OF-BAND — start an OOB (DNS/HTTP) collaborator with a UNIQUE token BEFORE firing, or the proof is unrecoverable.

A single host-validation bypass fails when the FETCHER re-parses the URL — the bug needs TWO parsers that disagree (validator sees one host, fetcher connects to another); confirm the disagreement with a differential-URL corpus first.

Poison-and-observe smuggling detection is unsafe (it harms other users) and flaky — use a timing-HANG boolean detect, then a SELF-targeted confirm (smuggle GET /404 that alters only your own next response).

Naive concurrent timing races lose to network jitter — use HTTP/2 single-packet / last-byte-sync to collapse arrival spread to ~1ms and make the race deterministic enough to PROVE; verify the single packet in Wireshark.

ANCHORING GUARD: an exemplar's proof_oracle is a HINT for what to PRODUCE, never a citation of proof. Re-derive the oracle on THIS live target through the leash; a remembered/guessed flag, a bare 200, or 'the exemplar proves it' is NOT proof and the oracle gate must reject it.
A Jinja2 RCE payload fails on Twig (and vice-versa) — never guess the engine; fingerprint via the delimiter that evaluates and the (1/0).zxy error type, THEN select the engine-keyed payload.

A 403 to another user's object is a 'wrong door', not a 'wall' — many authz checks gate only the logged-in-wrong-user path; try DE-escalating identity (drop all cookies / go anonymous) as well as escalating it.

CLEAN-TARGET: if a two-principal differential shows no cross-tenant read/write after the FULL param sweep (swap + strip + substitute every *_id and every ?include/sideload), the object is genuinely scoped — STOP, do not force a finding.

CLEAN-TARGET: if every metadata path, gopher scheme, DNS-rebinding and path-traversal variant returns identical benign output and no OOB callback fires, the fetch is genuinely egress-restricted/validated — STOP.

CLEAN-TARGET: if the polyglot and every delimiter ({{7*7}} / ${7*7} / #{7*7} / <%=7*7%>) render literally with no eval, no engine error and no time-delay on the blind branch, there is no template injection — STOP.
CLEAN-TARGET: if error, boolean, time AND OOB oracles are all silent across the parameter after encoding/charset variants, the parameter is not injectable — STOP.
CLEAN-TARGET: if the payload is reflected but context-encoded and no EXECUTION oracle (blind-XSS callback / headless-browser assert) fires, it is a reflected string, not XSS — STOP.
CLEAN-TARGET: if the bypass header/path yields a 200 whose body EQUALS the guarded/WAF body (no differential vs a proven-guarded baseline), it is not a bypass — STOP.
CLEAN-TARGET: if no heap/libc leak is obtainable, modern-libc (safe-linking) poison cannot be aimed — STOP and hunt a leak primitive first; do not blind-poison.
CLEAN-TARGET: if neither OOB nor a php://filter round-trip returns file bytes after param-entity + inline-DTD variants on a <8.4 target, the parser is genuinely hardened — STOP.
CLEAN-TARGET: if the CNAME resolves to a claimed/serving resource (no unclaimed-resource fingerprint), there is no takeover — STOP, do not attempt to register the resource.
CLEAN-TARGET: if introspection is disabled AND no mutation accepts a foreign object id across the sweep, the schema is scoped — STOP.

A reflected 'rO0AB' echo or an ACCEPTED serialized blob is NOT RCE - many endpoints accept/store a blob without ever deserializing it to a gadget sink. Require an OOB callback for a unique token or command output; prove blind before any id.

A reflected %{...}/${...}/#{...} in an error page is NOT execution. Require arithmetic REDUCTION (49) then command output. Modern Struts/OGNL often ships a SecurityManager/allowlist that blocks Runtime - a reduction with no command path is HIGH (server-side eval), not critical; do not inflate.

A 500, a length delta, or a timing wobble is NOT RCE. Require an OOB callback for YOUR unique interactsh token with src-IP = the target (never 127.0.0.1 or our own egress - origin-check veto), or returned command output. Log4Shell: a DNS-only callback still proves the lookup fired.

A bare 200 on /actuator/health, a reachable .js.map, or /.git/HEAD existing is NOT a finding. The leaked value must be EXERCISED across a boundary (token->401/403->200 private content; cred logs in; key signs). Actuator with management.security on returns 200 health but 401 on /env - check the sensitive endpoint, not health.
